title: Umami Heimat Frittata
description: A rich and savory egg dish packed with the bold flavors of umami and heimat.
instructions: Whisk eggs in a bowl and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tsp of umami over medium heat.
Add chopped heimat and cook until wilted.
Pour whisked eggs over the heimat mixture.
Transfer skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Slice into wedges and serve hot.
